title: v1.0.6: Security Hardening and Access Controls
text:
Security upgrades are now part of our default delivery baseline for all active client systems.

  • MFA enforcement for privileged accounts
  • Improved audit logging across key workflows
  • Backup verification checklist added to maintenance cycles

title: v1.0.5: Website Performance and UX Refresh
text:
We rolled out front-end improvements focused on faster load times and cleaner user journeys for business websites.

  • Optimized navigation hierarchy for service pages
  • Improved accessibility states for forms and buttons
  • Reduced layout shift and page load bottlenecks

title: v1.0.4: Internal Workflow Automation Pack
text:
New workflow modules help teams reduce repetitive manual tasks and keep status tracking consistent.

  • Task ownership states standardized
  • Approval steps mapped to role-based access
  • Operational reminders added to recurring processes

title: v1.0.3: Stability and Maintenance Update
text:
Maintenance-focused release to keep deployments stable as client systems scale.

  • Dependency patch cycle completed
  • Error monitoring cleanup and alert tuning
  • Bug fixes for edge-case form submissions

title: v1.0.2: Integration Layer Expansion
text:
Expanded integration support for businesses working across multiple tools and operational platforms.

  • HubSpot contact and pipeline sync
  • Zoho CRM lead field mapping
  • Webhook retry handling for failed delivery events

title: v1.0.1: Foundation Release
text:
Initial release of the Whynt delivery baseline for SMB software projects.

  • Core project scaffolding and deployment pipeline
  • Base analytics and conversion tracking setup
  • Documentation template for handover and support
